`recorded-short-plan.json` is the actual unauthenticated production API response
saved on October 6, 2026 for Chicago, IL → Springfield, IL → St. Louis, MO with
20 cycle hours used. Whitespace was removed; coordinates, events and totals
were preserved. It supplies deterministic data for mobile presentation tests.
The other browser tests still call the real routing API.

Road routing: OSRM. Location data: Photon / OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL.
